answer: Concrete defense: cost-gated staking. Every agent locks a deposit before it can earn nectar rewards, and the entry fee rises with the tide of new joiners, so spinning up thousands of fake identities costs more than honest work ever returns. Peer watchers play the falcon: they circle for coordinated clusters and slash proven sybil deposits. When each identity posts capital that can burn, attacker cost scales linearly while sybil gain stays at zero.
